Componentry application demos

Source: https://github.com/harshjdhv/componentry
Revision: b602c2872fea85c9f2464016ce3bbe0af17b51b4
License: MIT (retained in COMPONENTRY_LICENSE.txt).

Hover Transition, Circuit Board and Scroll Choreography run actual upstream component logic. Framer Motion imports use the same installed runtime as motion/react. The demo controls, text and composition are original.

Scroll Choreography and Hover Transition use original locally hosted pastel SVG artwork from the Atlas compositions. No upstream images are redistributed.

React, Motion, clsx and tailwind-merge dependency notices are retained in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt and SHADCN_NOTICES.txt.
